notes.naming: short codes -- the space is named this way and 6,399 stories are already filed under it; the front end expands short to long for the public URL
notes.seedTemplateReadFrom: regions/test, the folder the dev created to show the shape

actions.keep: exists, in the right place -- do nothing
actions.adopt: exists in Storyblok, the DB has no row -- write the id in
actions.create: the pages plan needs it and it is not there -- create it and seed its leaves

notes.renames: none. The space short code wins, so no folder is renamed and no story moves. Where the pages plan uses a different slug it is listed under "aliases" -- one folder, two names.
notes.containerFolders: the entities folder under a region and the departments folder under an entity are seeded by the backend when the row gets its first child. They are reported per node as entitiesFolder and departmentsFolder, not as work.
